scope: Public implementations of native Chrome online Google Pay with microG on Huawei Android-compatible firmware
conclusion: No complete publicly verifiable implementation found in this search; related partial and adjacent work exists. This does not prove no implementation exists.
method: Web search; GitHub repository and issue/PR metadata searches; upstream/ReVanced wallet source retrieval; review of primary project documentation. Not an exhaustive code/fork audit.

sources.name: microG wallet support
sources.finding: Open support request; largely NFC/Android Pay context, not proof of all web-payment limitations.

sources.name: microG IAP security verification
sources.finding: Merged IAP security verification and related native UI; not a Chrome web-payment provider.

sources.name: microG current wallet source
sources.finding: isReadyToPay returns false; getClientToken returns internal error; loadWebPaymentData absent.

sources.name: ReVanced wallet source
sources.finding: Fetched file identical to current upstream stub at research time.

sources.name: microG Play Store/Integrity workarounds
sources.finding: Rooted Android 13+ custom ROM attestation, Store privileges and provenance; does not implement wallet payments.

sources.name: Google Pay India app allowance
sources.finding: App compatibility change; not evidence of global card-based Google Pay provider.

sources.name: Google merchant Android sample
sources.finding: Calls Google Play services; does not replace the device payment provider.

sources.name: GrapheneOS sandboxed Play
sources.finding: OS-integrated compatibility layer for original Google packages; not a drop-in microG backend.
